crochet5DcPopcorn.name: 5-dc-popcorn
crochet5DcPopcorn.label: 5-dc popcorn
crochet5DcPopcorn.meaning: 5-dc popcorn. Work 5 dc into the same stitch. Drop the loop from the hook and insert hook into the first dc of the group. Pull the dropped loop through the first dc to close, creating a 3d nubble. Shown as five ticked stems in an almond outline with a horizontal bar through the middle indicating the closure.
